Domain: Geography
Description: State and province lookup table.
Fields:
  - name (character varying(50)): Full official name of the state or province (e.g., California, Ontario)
  - territoryid (integer(32,0)): Foreign key to the sales territory this state or province is assigned to for regional reporting
  - isonlystateprovinceflag (boolean): Flag indicating if this is the only state or province in its country (rarely used, for special cases like Washington DC)

  - stateprovinceid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Primary key identifier for the state or province record
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp recording when the state or province record was last updated
  - rowguid (uuid): Globally unique identifier used for database replication and synchronization
  - countryregioncode (character varying(3)) [FK]: Foreign key linking to the country this state or province belongs to
